naske01.title: How do I slow down when I really like someone?
naske01.caption: Liking someone fast is not a problem. Let the plans grow one date at a time, and ask what pace feels good to them too.

naske02.title: They love new things. I love my routine.
naske02.caption: Your routine is allowed to be your comfort. Try a trade: one old favorite, one new thing. Small yeses count.

naske03.title: I lose interest after the first few dates.
naske03.caption: The first spark always changes shape. Sometimes bored just means not curious yet, so bring a deeper question to date four.

naske04.title: How do I let them take care of me?
naske04.caption: If you are always the one tucking everyone in, let some of that care come back. When they offer, try just saying thank you.

naske05.title: What if they don't like my friends?
naske05.caption: First hangouts are awkward for everyone. Ask what felt off and listen first. You do not have to choose; let your worlds blend slowly.

naske06.title: I keep trying to fix their problems.
naske06.caption: Sometimes they want a listener, not a fix. Ask whether they want advice or a hug, and follow their lead either way.

naske07.title: I say yes to every party. I'm exhausted.
naske07.caption: A kind no is still kind: "I can't this time, but I'd love to soon." Rest makes you better company. Save this for the busy weeks.

naske08.title: I hold grudges. How do I let go?
naske08.caption: Holding on can feel safe, and it is also heavy. Say what hurt, once, out loud. Then see if you are ready to set it down.

naske09.title: I said something too honest. Now what?
naske09.caption: Honesty matters, and so does how it lands. Go back, say "that came out wrong, sorry," then say what you meant, more gently.

naske10.title: How do I relax on a date?
naske10.caption: You do not need a plan for every minute. Pick one thing to do and let the rest happen. The best part is usually the part you did not plan.

naske11.title: I'm bad at saying how I feel.
naske11.caption: You do not need perfect words. "I like spending time with you" works. Say it once, and it gets easier after.

naske12.title: I cry at everything. Is that too much?
naske12.caption: Feeling deeply is not too much. The right person will not ask you to feel less. If you need words: "I'm okay, I'm just moved."
